title: ExecutionPlan
description:
Topologically sorted task DAG.

Stages are produced in dependency-layer order. Stage 0 contains all tasks with no dependencies. Each later stage contains tasks whose dependencies were all emitted by earlier stages.

stages.description: Topological execution layers in dependency order.

task_count.description: Total task count across all stages. Equals `tasks.len()` from the input map.

Stage.description:
One topological execution layer.

Tasks within a stage are independent and may execute in parallel.

tasks.description: Task ids in this stage, sorted lexicographically for determinism.
